concept.name: Area under ROC curve
concept.definition: The area beneath the ROC curve, equivalently the probability that a randomly selected positive receives a higher score than a randomly selected negative, with tie handling.
concept.intuition: It summarizes one aspect of prediction error or decision quality in a number or curve.
concept.mechanics: Compute the ROC curve across thresholds and numerically integrate true-positive rate with respect to false-positive rate.
concept.formula: AUC = integral of TPR with respect to FPR
concept.failure_modes: Class imbalance, threshold choice, unequal error costs, outliers, and dependence can make the summary inappropriate or unstable.
concept.misconceptions: No single metric captures economic utility, turnover, risk, calibration, and trading costs at once.
concept.example: An AUC of 0.70 means a random positive outranks a random negative about 70% of the time under the metric's tie convention.
